svg.title: Vitalii Borovyk's GitHub contributions as a landscape: 9,990 contributions · Oct 2025 – Oct 2026
svg.desc: One plateau per week, 53 plateaus from left to right. Plateau height is the square root of its total, capped at 888 contributions (the 99th percentile of the totals); empty weeks stay on the ground. A walker crosses the year in a 135-second loop, climbing ladders and ropes between plateaus, with a different challenge on every week: he saws trees and pushes boulders on the busiest ones, and plants a flag by the campfire on the busiest: 888 contributions · Sep 27 – Oct 3, 2026.
